title: hConsistency operation
description: Enthalpy-surface identity audit: checks that the assembled package's enthalpy route is internally consistent for the named components at one temperature. A pure numerical identity on the package's own H surface — it needs no experimental data and answers a question the tutorials cannot: whether the rungs a component's record pins actually compose.

components.title: Components to audit
components.description: The components whose enthalpy route is checked.

temperature.title: Audit temperature
temperature.description: Temperature at which the identity is evaluated; defaults to 350 K.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
